card.name: Single-letter command options and Serra
card.fires_on: The letter a (or b, e) right after a dash, plus or percent sign in command-line options and date formats. Also "erra" inside the place name Serra.

modes.label: Command option letter
modes.description: A single letter flag after - or + or % in shell commands or date format strings.

modes.label: Serra place names
modes.description: The "erra" part of Serra in Portuguese or Spanish place names and surnames.
modes.example: A Flora of the S<<erra>> da Juréia is in preparation.

card.plain: It fires on a lone option letter such as the a in -a, and on the middle of the name Serra.
